verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a public REST API for integrating with third-party systems. It can list and inspect clients, retrieve session history, close active sessions, edit session comments and client aliases, and ships with an open-source Python module. A documented CLI separately automates install, configuration and session start. The API scope is mainly account and session administration rather than full programmatic control of remote sessions, and probes found no machine-readable spec. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (all probed paths 404), REST-level session initiation or remote-control actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
